caption: A new client fills in a short brief on the studio’s website, in their own words
They get a reference straight away. Behind the scenes, the assistant lists the work asked for, without any prices
The assistant drafts the wording: what we heard, what we will make, and questions before we start
Every price comes from the studio’s own rate card by fixed rules. What is not on the card is left for a person
The owner decides: approve and send, approve with changes, or do not send
Every proposal is logged with the owner’s decision. A vague brief stops with the owner and nothing goes out
Three working days without a reply, a follow-up draft waits for the owner. It never goes out by itself
